title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
Principal Database Engineer
description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s Core Infrastructure Engineering team builds and operates the shared data systems behind critical production services. Our estate spans on-premises and cloud infrastructure, with MariaDB at its centre and Kafka, Redis and Elasticsearch across the wider platform.

We’re hiring a Principal Database Engineer to bring long-term experience and technical judgment to this estate. You’ll assess it, set the goals and direction, and work hands-on with the team to deliver measurable improvements. This is an individual contributor role with influence across teams and several quarters of work.

 

The opportunity

  • Review the estate against business needs and production evidence. Judge reliability, scale, cost and operational complexity, identifying what should be preserved and where investment or simplification would make a difference.

  • Define the target architecture and measurable goals. Agree a prioritised roadmap with engineering leads and dependent teams, explaining the trade-offs and sequencing work around delivery risks.

  • Execute that roadmap with the team through design, implementation and adoption. Stay personally involved in difficult migrations and scaling decisions, with representative benchmarks, data-integrity checks and credible cutover and rollback plans. Adapt the plan as evidence changes and verify the results in production before calling the work complete.

  • Investigate difficult MariaDB failures and performance limits through the engine, storage and application behaviour. Improve fleet reliability through useful observability, safer changes and tested backup, restore and disaster recovery procedures. Set recovery objectives with service owners and prove them through exercises.

  • Build and maintain production software for database provisioning, upgrades and routine maintenance. Make self-service workflows safe and auditable, incorporating access controls and change evidence with Security and Compliance.

  • Work with application teams on schemas, transaction boundaries, queries and data-store choices. Make the operational consequences clear and resolve dependencies that span teams.

  • Mentor engineers across the team through design reviews, pairing and incident analysis. Help them deepen their database expertise and take ownership of technical decisions.

  • Participate in on-call and incident response, leaving clear operational ownership and following through on lessons from production.

 

What you bring

  • 8+ years operating and evolving production database estates at scale. You have assessed inherited systems, set technical direction and delivered improvements with engineering teams, and can explain how those decisions held up over time.

  • Strong understanding of high availability, replication and distributed database failure modes. You can explain consistency and availability trade-offs and reason about transaction boundaries and reliable event delivery, including transactional outbox patterns.

  • Deep, recent hands-on MariaDB expertise, including InnoDB, MVCC and transaction isolation, locking, query optimisation, binary logs and MariaDB GTID replication. You can explain the mechanisms and diagnostic evidence behind your decisions.

  • Personal ownership of MariaDB incident diagnosis, performance tuning and tested restore or point-in-time recovery. You can explain what you did, how you established data integrity and what remained uncertain.

  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, Rust or a comparable language. You have personally built and maintained production software or automation for database workflows such as provisioning, failover, online schema changes and self-service operations, using version control, code review and delivery pipelines, with tested failure handling.

  • Strong low-level Linux, Kernel, storage and networking fundamentals, with the ability to investigate problems beyond the database process.

  • Clear written technical judgment and demonstrated delivery across teams without reporting-line authority. You help stakeholders make sound database design and lifecycle decisions, and develop experienced engineers through shared delivery.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience operating databases in containerised, hybrid on-premises/cloud or multi-region environments. Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code or GitOps, including their operational trade-offs.

  • Experience with database proxies or load-balancing layers (MaxScale, HAProxy, ProxySQL, or similar).

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Vitess, TiDB, ScyllaDB, ClickHouse or internal database platforms; operational knowledge of Kafka, Redis/Valkey or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

  • Experience in regulated environments or contributions to database engines, operators and other infrastructure software.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Marketing/Sales Data Analyst Fund Investments
description:
coni + partner, established 1993, is a consultancy company with headquarters in Zurich and subsidiaries in Düsseldorf and Shanghai. We are specialised in custom-fit staffing in tune with the corporate culture by ensuring a perfect match of professional skills, references and personal as well as social skills of successful candidates.

Our client is the asset management division of an international bank in Zurich. We are looking for data scientists (m, f, d) with experience in the fund business as

Marketing/Sales Data Analyst Fund Investments

Your Tasks:

Promoting growth as part of the corporate strategy by leveraging the full potential of fund investment, contract data and client behaviour / Reviewing, analyzing, coordinating, and preparing fund data for marketing, sales, and investor relations purposes, including data in fund databases related to structured questionnaires (DDQ), requests for proposals (RFPs), requests for information (RFIs), contracts, and related business documents / Analyzing complex data sets across various platforms to gain key insights into investor behavior / Providing key data insights and trends to support business initiatives and promote relevant communication with clients / Translating insights derived from fund data into actionable projects, timelines, and compliance requirements / Taking responsibility for data quality and contributing ideas and suggestions to improve the data architecture / Applying analytical and technical expertise to support consistent, client-centric omnichannel communication / Optimizing automated data workflows and AI-powered tools to contribute to the continuous improvement of the department’s quality / Ad hoc projects.

Your Profile:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in quantitative finance, econometrics or economics / Good knowledge of fund products / Essential: 2 to 3 years’ professional experience in data science following graduation, with a focus on marketing- or sales-oriented projects in the fund industry, e.g. as a quantitative consultant at one of the ‘Big Four’ accountancy firms or as a data scientist at a major asset manager / Interest in the use of AI-supported tools / Proficiency in Python, SQL and big data technologies / Strong analytical, communication and project management skills, as well as the ability and motivation to deliver high-quality business results in a demanding environment / A personality capable of taking a holistic view of both the details and the bigger picture / Team-oriented and open to discussion, with a collegial manner / High level of self-motivation and problem-solving skills / Experience of working with cross-functional business teams / Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment / Interest in project and coordination tasks / German and English.

title: Senior Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer (76080)
description:
Wir suchen für einen Kunden einen erfahrenen Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer. Dabei übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle zwischen Business und Technologie: Du verstehst Geschäftsprozesse und Bedürfnisse im Kern, strukturierst komplexe Anforderungen und schaffst die Grundlage für Lösungen, die fachlich sinnvoll und technisch umsetzbar sind. Dabei bist du nicht einfach Anforderungsmanager, sondern Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden und unsere interdisziplinären Teams. Folgende Aufgaben warten: Analyse und Strukturierung komplexer fachlicher Problemstellungen, Geschäftsprozesse und Anforderungen mit Fokus auf das eigentliche Problem hinter der Anfrage; Planung und Moderation von Interviews, Workshops und Reviews; Erhebung, Strukturierung, Priorisierung und Validierung von Anforderungen sowie Erarbeitung geeigneter Fachkonzepte, Modelle und Spezifikationen; Erarbeitung präziser, prüfbarer Spezifikationen und Kontrakte als verlässliche «Single Source of Truth» für Entwicklung und Testing; Analyse von Schnittstellen, Datenflüssen, Rollen und Systemgrenzen; Abstimmung zwischen Fachbereichen, UX, Architektur, Entwicklung, Test und Betrieb; Begleitung von Anforderungen von der ersten Idee bis zu fachlichen Tests und Abnahmen und Aktive Weiterentwicklung unserer Methoden und Kompetenzen in Business Analysis und Requirements Engineering

  • Mehrjährige fundierte Erfahrung als Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle in komplexen IT-Vorhaben
  • Erfahrung mit modernen Spezifikations- und Modellierungsansätzen (z. B. Spec-Driven Development)
  • Du bist geübt darin, Geschäftsprozesse, Abläufe und Systemzusammenhänge mit geeigneten Modellierungsnotationen wie BPMN und UML verständlich darzustellen
  • Offenheit für Veränderungen und den Einsatz von KI in der Konzeption
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Französischkenntnisse
  • Idealerweise bringst du einen Abschluss in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebsökonomie oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung mit oder verfügst über entsprechende langjährige Praxiserfahrung.
  • IREB CPRE, IIBA CBAP/CCBA oder vergleichbare Zertifizierungen
  • Weiterbildung in Requirements Engineering, Business Analysis oder Digital Transformation
  • Erfahrung mit Spezifikations- und Modellierungs-Tools (z. B. Innovator, Sparx Enterprise Architect, Adonis)
  • Erfahrung mit HERMES, Scrum oder SAFe
  • Erfahrung im öffentlichen oder bundesnahen Umfeld

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

title: Operations analyst - Transfers
description:
Hybrid with 2 days a week in our Edinburgh or Bath office

 

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform that’s on a mission to helping more people to invest – and invest well.

 

We’re B-Corp certified with an amazing product-market fit, impressive early traction and the potential to transform an outdated industry, for the better. We've been growing fast and will scale even faster over the next few years.

 

We’re also proud to be part of Octopus, the £multi billion group that's on a mission to breathe new life into broken industries, through companies like Octopus Energy, Octopus Investments and Octopus Money.

 

Check out the Seccl website for the latest on our products and our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

The role

We’re looking for an Operations analyst to join our Transfers team, where you’ll be responsible for processing transfers accurately and on time across multiple wrapper types. This is a fast paced and varied role that will require you to adapt quickly to changing priorities, move seamlessly between different tasks and processes, and stay focused in a busy operational environment.

You’ll balance pace with precision, managing competing demands while consistently delivering high quality outcomes. Working closely with colleagues across Operations and our customer facing teams, you’ll help processes run efficiently and resolve queries and issues within agreed service levels. Alongside day to day processing, you’ll use your operational knowledge and experience to improve processes, reduce risk and support automation, helping us build a more scalable and resilient operations function for the future.

 

On a typical day you will be…

  • Supporting your Senior analyst with regular business reporting

  • An analytical problem solver, delivery focussed and a trusted member of the team, you will support the wider business by answering queries in a timely manner

  • Investigating and taking end to end ownership of our transfer processes. Ensuring issues are resolved in line with regulatory and customer agreed SLAs

  • Reviewing operational workflow and, where possible, suggesting process improvements

  • Working closely with the customer, product and engineering teams to explore better ways of working and to support our scalability

  • Supporting with training for new members of the team

  • Supporting other areas of Operations as and when required

 

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a good understanding of the platform industry

  • You have proven experience in handling transfers efficiently

  • You have the ability to identify, analyse and resolve any complex issues working to strict deadlines

  • You have good domain knowledge of investment platforms, particularly knowledge of the CASS environment

  • You have strong communication and organisation skills with the ability to describe to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

     

What’s in it for you…

 

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

 

💰 A salary between £30,000 and £35,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate - our recognition programme that offers a mix of flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

 

Our culture

 

We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation.

 

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this, (following an initial chat with one of our Talent team):

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager

  • Second stage – one-hour technical interview or assessment

     

⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.

 

🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

 

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you!
